convexExtended_coe_iff:
theorem convexExtended_coe_iff {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    (f : E → ℝ) : IsConvexExtended (fun x => (f x : EReal)) ↔ ConvexOn ℝ univ f
